parameters.text:
={{ $json.context }}

You are a health data sync agent. Complete ALL of these steps in order:

1. Fetch Oura daily_readiness data
2. Fetch Oura daily_sleep data
3. Fetch Oura daily_activity data
4. Fetch Oura daily_stress data
5. Fetch Oura sleep sessions (for HRV)
6. Get the existing health_data.js file from GitHub (you need its SHA for the update)
7. Merge all fetched data into a unified daily timeline. Preserve any Apple Health data already in the existing file.
8. Write the updated health_data.js back to GitHub
9. Return a 3-sentence plain-English health insight summarising the most recent 7 days of data — readiness trend, sleep quality, HRV pattern, and one actionable recommendation.

Always use start_date={{ $('📅 Build Context').item.json.start_date }} and end_date={{ $('📅 Build Context').item.json.end_date }} for all Oura API calls.

The health_data.js file must follow this format exactly:
// Auto-generated by n8n agent — [generated_at]
const HEALTH_DATA = {"stats":{...},"timeline":[...],"workouts":[...]};

Do not skip any step. Confirm each tool call result before proceeding to the next step.

options.systemMessage: You are a precise health data orchestration agent. You have access to tools to fetch Oura Ring biometric data and read/write files on GitHub. Execute each step methodically. If a tool call fails, retry once before reporting the error. Always preserve existing Apple Health data when updating the GitHub file.

parameters.name: fetch_oura_readiness
parameters.description: Fetches Oura Ring daily readiness scores including HRV balance, body temperature, recovery index, resting heart rate, and sleep balance contributors. Requires start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

parameters.name: fetch_oura_sleep
parameters.description: Fetches Oura Ring daily sleep scores and contributors including deep sleep, REM sleep, efficiency, latency, restfulness, timing, and total sleep duration. Requires start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

parameters.name: fetch_oura_activity
parameters.description: Fetches Oura Ring daily activity data including steps, active calories, total calories, activity score, high/medium/low activity time, and sedentary time. Requires start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

parameters.name: fetch_oura_stress
parameters.description: Fetches Oura Ring daily stress data including stress_high minutes, recovery_high minutes, and day_summary. Requires start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

parameters.name: fetch_oura_sleep_sessions
parameters.description: Fetches detailed Oura Ring sleep sessions including average_hrv, average_heart_rate, lowest_heart_rate, deep/light/REM/awake durations, efficiency, latency, bedtime_start, bedtime_end, restless_periods, and average_breath. Use this to get HRV data. Requires start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

parameters.name: get_health_data_file
parameters.description: Gets the current health_data.js file from GitHub. Returns the file content (base64 encoded) and the SHA needed to update it. Always call this before writing the file.

parameters.name: write_health_data_file
parameters.description: Writes the updated health_data.js file to GitHub. Requires: message (commit message string), content (base64-encoded file content string), sha (current file SHA from get_health_data_file), branch='main'. The content must be the complete health_data.js file base64-encoded.

meta.description:
Agent-based health data sync. A single Claude Sonnet agent orchestrates all Oura API calls, merges data, commits to GitHub, and writes a daily health insight — replacing 12 disparate nodes with one intelligent agent + 7 tools.

Credentials to add in n8n:
1. 'Oura Bearer Token' → Settings > Credentials > HTTP Header Auth
   Header Name: Authorization | Value: Bearer YOUR_OURA_TOKEN
   Get token: https://cloud.ouraring.com/personal-access-tokens

2. 'GitHub PAT' → HTTP Header Auth
   Header Name: Authorization | Value: token YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN
   Needs: repo + workflow scopes

3. 'Anthropic API' → Anthropic credential type
   API Key: sk-ant-...

4. SMTP credentials for Email node (or swap for Slack/Gmail node)

Note: Uses Claude Sonnet for the agent brain (more reliable for multi-step tool orchestration than Haiku).
